title: ProductPrd:EnterpriseSuite

_meta.purpose: Enterprise suite PRD: native business operating system bundling HR, Payroll, Accounting, compliance evidence, approvals, and operating intelligence under shared Workflow/Object Graph/ops contracts.

identity.ops_surface: managed through OpenTofu-owned infrastructure, root Makefile bootstrap/install/plan/apply targets, and oya ops surfaces; no manual SSH troubleshooting path
identity.suite_boundary: business operating system shell; child products own runtime domains while sharing identity, policy, approval, Workflow, Object Graph, audit-chain, and ops seams

user_decisions: 2026-05-16:D-13 one PRD per suite plus per-app sub-PRDs
2026-05-16:D-15 canonical PRD form is JSON-with-pointers at specs/products/<id>.json
2026-05-16:enterprise scope starts with HR, Payroll, Accounting and remains extensible for every business SaaS module
2026-05-16:deployment must be OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops; no manual SSH troubleshooting
2026-05-16:shell-script operations must move to Rust where logic exists
2026-05-16:D-15 canonical PRD form is JSON-with-pointers at specs/microservices/<id>.json

target_users.interface: approval queue, team dashboard, exception handling
admin console, imports, policies, close workflow
legal hold, audit evidence, statutory filing and control evidence

acceptance_criteria.when: HR, Payroll, and Accounting children are enabled
acceptance_criteria.then: all writes carry tenant_id, legal_entity_id, data_class, and audit-chain evidence without child apps bypassing the suite policy gateway

acceptance_criteria.given: a Korean group has multiple legal entities
acceptance_criteria.then: each entity keeps an independent payroll/accounting close boundary and immutable evidence while group dashboards use projections only
all day-2 changes route through Makefile/oya ops/ops.oyatie.com and no SSH troubleshooting command is required

acceptance_criteria.given: a workflow crosses HR, Payroll, and Accounting
acceptance_criteria.when: approval, evidence, or rollback is required
acceptance_criteria.then: Workflow owns routing and Object Graph owns typed relationships; AI suggestions cannot close deterministic gates

acceptance_criteria.given: a production incident or canary SLO breach occurs
acceptance_criteria.then: rollback/quarantine happens first, incident JSON/evidence is emitted, and infra/config fixes converge through OpenTofu/ops

out_of_scope.why: deployment-ops contract forbids troubleshooting through ad hoc SSH
external suites are import/coexistence adapters only
deterministic Workflow, rulepack, and audit-chain evidence are closure authority

optimization_practices.implementation: tenant_id + legal_entity_id + region route every transactional write; group rollups are projections, not shared mutable ledgers
Workflow queues expose SLA and exception budgets before operator inboxes overload
payroll, accounting, compliance, and incident workflows emit immutable evidence paths before promotion/resume

packs.notes: Korea-first HR/payroll/accounting fidelity: Labor Standards Act, 4대보험, HomeTax, K-GAAP/K-IFRS, PIPA, ISMS-P, SAPA, rules-of-employment and labor-management-council thresholds.
US expansion keeps payroll tax, benefits, FMLA/ADA/EEOC, GAAP, SOX-style controls, and multi-state employer obligations behind jurisdiction rulepacks.
EU expansion covers GDPR, works-council/local labor overlays, VAT, statutory accounting exports, and data-residency policy.

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: unified-suite shell with child product launch contracts
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday — single data model across HCM and Finance modules
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: suite policy gateway + legal_entity_context shared across HR/Payroll/Accounting children

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: role-based self-service portal: employee / manager / HR admin tiers
industry_patterns_adopted.source: ADP Workforce Now, BambooHR — tiered self-service UX reduces admin burden
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: EnterprisePolicyDisclosureBanner + EnterpriseWorkQueueList scoped per persona tier

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: SSO / SAML 2.0 / OIDC identity provider federation
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Rippling — enterprise IdP federation required for suite adoption
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: suite shell delegates identity to workspace IdP seam; SAML/OIDC adapter in Connect layer

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: ISO 27001 + SOC 2 Type II compliance evidence generation
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday, NetSuite, ADP — enterprise procurement mandates these certifications
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: audit-chain WORM evidence + deployment-ops-contract gate covers SOC 2 control evidence; ISMS-P binding via KR pack

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: explicit data residency controls per region
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday, SAP — GDPR + data sovereignty require explicit region pinning
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: ops_cell includes region pin; tenant data routing enforces residency at Postgres RLS + object store level

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: multi-currency with FX rate snapshot at transaction time
industry_patterns_adopted.source: NetSuite, Xero, Sage Intacct — global enterprise requires >3 currency pairs
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: currency_handling extended to KRW, USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, CNY, AUD; FX rate snapshot stored on JournalVoucher and WageLedgerEntry

industry_patterns_adopted.pattern: approval inbox with SLA budgets and escalation
industry_patterns_adopted.source: Workday — inbox-driven approval with configurable SLA thresholds
industry_patterns_adopted.implementation: Workflow queues expose SLA and exception budgets; operator inbox backpressure before overload

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: single global mutable ledger across legal entities
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: NetSuite multi-subsidiary anti-pattern — intercompany without elimination leads to double-counting
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: legal-entity cell isolation; group rollups are projections only, never shared mutable state

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: AI as sole compliance gate authority
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: Workday AI scheduling can conflict with labor law in some jurisdictions if not bounded
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: deterministic rulepacks are closure authority; AI may surface suggestions but cannot close gates

anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: SAP SuccessFactors KR payroll relies on partner network creating version-drift risk
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: native KR rulepack with effective-date versioning; no partner dependency for statutory close

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: manual SSH troubleshooting as documented recovery path
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: legacy ERP ops runbooks contain ad hoc SSH steps that bypass change control
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: deployment-ops contract forbids SSH troubleshooting; OpenTofu/Makefile/oya ops are only convergence path

anti_patterns_avoided.anti_pattern: monolithic close boundary across all tenants
anti_patterns_avoided.source_warning: shared close cycle causes cascading delays when one entity has exceptions
anti_patterns_avoided.mitigation: each legal entity closes independently; group close is a projection after all entity closes succeed

security.target: tenant, legal-entity, payroll, accounting, and evidence data remain RLS/policy isolated; privileged disclosure is audit chained

performance.target: operator hot paths p95 <= 200ms for preview and <= 150ms for GA under representative tenant shape

efficiency.target: unit economics tracked per employee, pay run, journal posting, evidence item, and workflow action

reliability.target: GA availability 99.95%; RPO <= 5m for professional data; rollback evidence emitted before root-cause analysis

user_experience.primary_navigation: suite shell with HR, Payroll, Accounting, approvals, evidence, and admin work queues; personal/work context boundaries inherited from the workspace shell where applicable

decision_log.decision: Machine-readable PRD JSON is canonical; no new Markdown PRD is introduced.
OpenTofu + Makefile + oya ops are the deployment/ops path; manual SSH troubleshooting is explicitly out of scope.
HR, Payroll, and Accounting are the first enterprise children; suite model remains extensible for procurement, compliance, assets, and corporate intelligence.

verification_limitations: Official vendor landing pages establish product/category presence and high-level capability areas only; this PR does not claim exhaustive feature parity verification.
New industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, and hyperscaler_bar entries are product-planning commitments until dedicated Enterprise validators land.
No runtime, CI lane, or schema validator for the new Enterprise hyperscaler_bar dimensions ships in this PR.
